found.truth_sql: SELECT (sumOrNull(if((toDateTime(toDate(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Australia/Sydney')), 'Australia/Sydney') >= toDateTime(toDate(toDateTime64('2025-06-15', 3, 'Australia/Sydney')), 'Australia/Sydney')), 1, 0)) / count()) AS c0 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE 1 SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
